channel.title: The Wang Report
channel.description: Independent news curation from Hong Kong: geopolitics, finance, cyber, AI, sports, science, and culture.

item.title: The Evening Briefing
item.description: Five developments for this evening.
item.dc:creator: Maarten Bakker

item.title: Tai Tong Shan Road and Tap Mun clearance removes 10 unauthorised burial sites
item.description: The remains have been reburied at Sandy Ridge Cemetery, with further burial-site notices planned before Ching Ming.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Stolen Railway credentials ran up about $740,000 in unauthorized AI usage
item.description: Railway promises to cover charges providers decline to refund, while customers still need to account for potentially exposed secrets.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: House votes 211 to 204 to block immediate Hegseth impeachment effort
item.description: The vote gives the defence secretary political protection while leaving allegations over the Iran war unresolved.
item.dc:creator: Mei Chen

item.title: Over 3,000 people died of preventable cholera in nine months of 2026
item.description: Nearly nine in 10 deaths were in Africa, despite a reported decline in mortality from the preventable and treatable infection.
item.dc:creator: Sora Whitlam

item.title: Eight signals distinguished 80% of unique Firefox users in fingerprint study
item.description: Measurements from almost 25 million users show how changing a few browser signals can make people harder to distinguish, while leaving tracking prevention unproven.
item.dc:creator: Magnus Honeyfield

item.title: Steven Tyler’s May 2027 sexual abuse trial centres on one California allegation
item.description: The judge will consider challenges to earlier restrictions, but most of Julia Misley’s claims remain excluded from trial.
item.dc:creator: Joy Lee

item.title: Ari K’s We Were Always Blue satire gives self-interest a charity choir
item.description: The published performance directions turn fictional founders’ appeals for forgiveness into an increasingly crowded display of sincerity.
item.dc:creator: Joy Lee

item.title: Trump questions midterm honesty after accepting the outcome
item.description: His November 9 accusations challenge an election the BBC reports gave Democrats control of both chambers of Congress.
item.dc:creator: Mei Chen

item.title: Northern Link cost estimate falls 28% to HK$86.2 billion as work starts
item.description: Construction is getting under way, but commuters still face a planned wait until 2034.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Trump says FBI is probing Jensen Huang as Nvidia opens its own inquiry
item.description: Federal, corporate and congressional scrutiny leave unresolved whether sensitive AI technology was compromised.
item.dc:creator: Aya Nakamura

item.title: Empty cookie lets Xen Orchestra attackers gain administrator privileges
item.description: The flaw can expose managed XCP-ng hosts to root takeover, while missing authentication logs limit what an administrator can establish afterward.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: Eisenkot gets 28 days to replace Netanyahu, with no majority secured
item.description: Coalition talks will also test whether the opposition can advance an independent inquiry into the October 7 attacks.
item.dc:creator: Mei Chen

item.title: Taizoom ordered to repair 720 lifts with required door frame parts missing
item.description: Taizoom must pay for the repairs, with different timetables for affected estates and private buildings.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Unused Qubole roles let an attacker steal secrets from AWS accounts
item.description: Dormant integrations reportedly admitted the attacker, while missing storage logs left some customers unable to establish which files had been read.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: Artex plans to restrict new releases while existing code stays online
item.description: More than 800 installations were reportedly accessible without passwords, creating a misuse risk even where their operators were legitimate security testers.
item.dc:creator: Aya Nakamura

item.title: US plans Ukraine security talks with Europe as Moscow holds to trilateral format
item.description: Planned consultations give Europe a channel into discussions on security guarantees, while its place in the negotiations remains unresolved.
item.dc:creator: Mei Chen

item.title: Morning roundup
item.description: A Hong Kong bank scam warning, COP31’s opening in Turkey and an NFL record in Kansas City.
item.dc:creator: Charmaine Lo

item.title: Scam alert related to banks flags fake China Construction Bank (Asia) app
item.description: Anyone who shared personal information or made a transaction should contact the bank and report it to police.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Kenneth Walker scores three touchdowns as Chiefs end two-game skid
item.description: Kansas City improved to 6-2, with Patrick Mahomes returning after hurting his right elbow and further testing still planned.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: Taiyuan high-rise fire; Hong Kong forecasts a cooler Tuesday
item.description: Also this evening: Britain considers easing its EV sales target, and BBC Scotland reports new testimony about alleged abuse at Balnagown.
item.dc:creator: Maarten Bakker

item.title: Weekly Journal
item.description: Democratic congressional victories and a sharp technology selloff, widening construction investigations in Hong Kong, and cyberattacks reaching refrigeration systems. Seven desk checkpoints through the end of Sunday, 8 November, Hong Kong time.
item.dc:creator: Walter Wang

item.title: Morning roundup
item.description: Hong Kong ransomware figures, the Giza train collision, Krakow’s investigation, Iris Plaza and the US album chart.
item.dc:creator: Charmaine Lo

item.title: Michael Jackson’s Thriller hits No. 2 on Billboard 200, its best since 1984
item.description: Halloween listening and new collectible editions helped lift an album that was already riding high, with streaming supplying the largest share of its chart total.
item.dc:creator: Joy Lee

item.title: Iris Plaza breach may expose up to 7.7 million customers, including non-members
item.description: Unauthorized access is confirmed, while the affected population remains under investigation and the company has not specified its password encryption scheme.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: Vanderbilt needs six Brock Taylor field goals to beat Mississippi State
item.description: Taylor supplied 19 points before a failed late two-point conversion finally secured Vanderbilt’s first SEC win of the season.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: Reported US$686 million upgrade renews US backing for Pakistan’s F-16 fleet
item.description: Critics in India accuse Washington of double standards, while the military effects of the reported commitment remain unverified.
item.dc:creator: Mei Chen

item.title: Tung Chung’s column count rises; Israel’s coalition arithmetic begins
item.description: Construction defects at home, a mandate without a majority in Israel, and fresh questions about who owns the screen, the voice and the keyboard.
item.dc:creator: Maarten Bakker

item.title: Sunday Morning: A flat fire, flooded tents and a Philharmonic premiere
item.description: Reporting published on 7 November 2026, with NASA’s next distance milestone still ahead.
item.dc:creator: Charmaine Lo

item.title: Hong Kong Should Judge the Exit as Well as the Entry
item.description: Crypto.com plans to end its Hong Kong consumer app services on February 1, 2027, while a separate exchange application remains pending.
item.dc:creator: Walter Wang

item.title: Tung Chung West station's defective column count rises from two to around 30
item.description: MTR has suspended relevant construction activities, while the Buildings Department says temporary supports preserve the station’s structural integrity.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Fox completes Roku deal with former Roku shareholders owning 26%
item.description: Roku joins Tubi and FOX One, while Fox promises continued access for other streaming providers.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Lam

item.title: Elvis Presley Enterprises sues Suno, alleging voice safeguards failed
item.description: The case puts song copyright and a singer’s vocal identity alongside each other, testing responsibility for AI imitations under Tennessee’s ELVIS Act.
item.dc:creator: Joy Lee

item.title: Trump says US struck Iranian air defence system, calling action ‘minor’
item.description: Iranian state media reported explosions on Qeshm Island, but the available reporting supplies no independent confirmation of the target or damage.
item.dc:creator: Mei Chen

item.title: What one light-day means for contacting Voyager 1
item.description: At that distance from Earth, even an immediate reply would require roughly 48 hours of radio travel.
item.dc:creator: Magnus Honeyfield

item.title: The latest developments
item.description: The latest developments across the day’s news.
item.dc:creator: Maarten Bakker

item.title: RTHK says FundHK claimed it as a partner without its agreement
item.description: Anyone weighing FundHK’s claimed institutional backing should know that RTHK says it authorised none of it.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: New Webb method delivers two to fifteen times better sensitivity in tests
item.description: Researchers recovered a known planet at a previously undetected wavelength by modelling the telescope changes that leave stellar glare behind.
item.dc:creator: Sora Whitlam

item.title: Hong Kong bid-rigging probe spans at least 20 buildings and estates, with 28 arrested
item.description: Authorities allege homeowners were rushed into signing, with affected owners’ corporations now promised assistance.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Fox buys Roku and commits to carry rival content for at least three years
item.description: Commitments cover rival content, search results, home-screen choices and sensitive data, while leaving parts of the future viewing experience unspecified.
item.dc:creator: Joy Lee

item.title: Derrick Henry ranks seventh in NFL career rushing as Ravens go nine drives scoreless
item.description: Henry passed two Hall of Famers while Jacksonville’s defense kept Baltimore’s celebration strictly individual.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: Macklemore says nine US arenas rejected Palestine benefits as MSG pushes back
item.description: European arena appearances supply context, but the reason his proposed US bookings failed remains unresolved.
item.dc:creator: Joy Lee

item.title: QNAP warns Plex2Shell patches leave attacker payloads on NAS devices
item.description: For vulnerable Plex servers exposed to the internet, QNAP’s reported guidance extends to a clean NAS operating-system reinstall and credential resets.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: Kospi falls more than 8%, triggering trading halt before closing down 6%
item.description: The BBC reported concerns over AI investment returns and possible US restrictions, while the Nasdaq retained a gain for the year.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Lam

item.title: Alexandra Eala beats Valentová in Hong Kong and details the physical toll
item.description: Eala explained the physical effort behind her run, but the supplied reports leave Friday’s result unconfirmed.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Scam alert related to banks flags fake Bank of China (Hong Kong) login
item.description: Anyone who shared personal information or made a transaction in response should contact the bank and report it to police.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: A short evening edition
item.description: A brief update for this evening.
item.dc:creator: Maarten Bakker

item.title: New York Times in advanced talks to buy Letterboxd with A24 out of running
item.description: Deadline confirms negotiations with owner Tiny, while the reported $330 million price and a prospective rival offer remain unsettled.
item.dc:creator: Joy Lee

item.title: CISA and FBI warn refrigeration hackers can alter and hide temperatures
item.description: The warning calls for securing remote access and enforcing safe temperature limits, while accounting for attacks that can also obscure temperature readings.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: HKEX profit falls 1 per cent on year and about 10 per cent from last quarter
item.description: The exchange operator’s first annual quarterly profit decline in 10 quarters still left earnings above analysts’ estimates.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Lam
